de in ast.walk(method) if isinstance(node, ast.Call)
             and isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute) and node.func.attr == 'from_config']
    assert len(calls) == 1 and 'journal' not in {kw.arg for kw in calls[0].keywords}
    assert 'journal' not in inspect.signature(Driver.from_config).parameters
    assert not any(isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(
        isinstance(target, ast.Attribute) and target.attr in {'journal', 'effects'}
        for target in node.targets) for node in ast.walk(method))
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='serve-custody-') as directory:
        baseline = asyncio.all_tasks()
        rig = CoreRig(Path(directory))
        assert_core_wiring(rig)
        checkout = rig.checkout
        llm = FakeLLM([])
        driver = Driver.from_config(checkout.config, llm=llm, env=checkout.env,
                                    clock=checkout.clock, sleep=checkout.sleep, fs=checkout.fs)
        assert driver.journal is not checkout.journal
        assert driver.effects._journal is driver.journal
        assert driver.effects._journal is not checkout.journal
        assert asyncio.all_tasks() == baseline
        assert llm.requests == [] and rig.exec.calls == [] and rig.fs.files == {}
        assert driver.journal.read() == checkout.journal.read() == []
        print(json.dumps({'head': head, 'base': base, 'status': await git.status_porcelain(repo),
              'triage_driver_shares_checkout_journal': driver.journal is checkout.journal,
              'triage_effects_share_checkout_journal': driver.effects._journal is checkout.journal,
              'model_calls': len(llm.requests), 'process_calls': len(rig.exec.calls)}))
    assert await git.status_porcelain(repo) == ''
